title: A new lane's branch name never contains "git", and a check refuses one that does
why: Claude Code's own worktree check (CLI 2.1.319) refuses agent git commands that name a branch containing "git": a switch to, a fetch of, or a PR opened from branch git-push-after-failed-commit. Seen three or more times in that lane on 2026-11-07.
note: Coordinator pick a, 14:51 CST: the false alarm is in the CLI, not a repo hook, so the fix is on our side: a new branch slug never holds "git", checked where branch names are read. Branches that exist keep their names. Red case first, then the check. A report upstream to Anthropic was not sent; that is the owner's call. Incident 01:42 CST Nov 10 (coordinator; lane git-dash-c-other-checkout, #2494): a push naming the lane branch was refused because the slug holds "git" twice; route used: `git push origin HEAD`.
